name: The Nightmare Manifests
label: Quest
description: The Nightmare Manifests: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We must use restraint against Eranikus. We are to redeem him not destroy him.
Tyrande is already en route to assist us in this task. We must weather the dragon's blows and save Nighthaven from certain destruction.
Be on guard! You and your allies are our only hope.

clips.title: Completion
paras: He is redeemed, friend. He now returns to the Dream to right what he alone has done wrong. Eranikus will be a powerful ally to Malfurion and my father.
These armaments are for you, friend; given to me by Ysera herself. You would do well to make use of them in your battles against the Qiraji.
